selection_reason: Stop over-investigating measurement tooling. A real application receive hot path performs ParseIPv4TCP(ip) for destination filtering, then rawOwnedIPv4TCP(ip), which clones and ParseIPv4TCP(owned) again. Every admitted valid packet is parsed twice.

candidate_change.control_flow: early parse/port/IP filter still on borrowed frame; copy ONLY accepted complete segment; keep borrowed parsed metadata then rebase Payload into copied wire by validated IHL and TCP data offset
candidate_change.ownership: return Segment.Payload aliases owned not kernel receive scratch
candidate_change.IP_trailing_padding: explicitly excluded by parsed payload length, no len(ip)-len(payload) shortcut
candidate_change.user_benefit_hypothesis: lower per-packet CPU time and shorten receive goroutine work between recvmmsg drains; socket overflow hypothesis NOT PROVEN

protection_tests.reference: original rawOwnedIPv4TCP copy-and-reparse still available and used as test oracle
cases: ACK with two SACK blocks and payload
protection_tests.after_mutation: original borrowed AF_PACKET scratch byte buffer is overwritten and both returned Segment and owned packet remain equal to reference
retained_existing_tests: sparse single packet no wait to fill
